<skill name="rust-review">
# Rust 服务代码审查

先用 `git_diff`（参数 `{"base": "HEAD~1"}`）查看本次变更。

## 规则

### panic-unwrap（error）
- 对可失败的输入使用 `unwrap()` / `expect()`：用户输入解析、Option 解包等
- 会导致服务 panic 的位置
- 注意：同一个语句里的多个 unwrap 算一个 finding
- rule_id: `panic-unwrap`

### sql-injection（error）
- 字符串拼接构造 SQL（`format!` 拼 SQL、`+` 拼 SQL）
- 应使用参数化查询
- rule_id: `sql-injection`

### hardcoded-secret（error）
- 源码中硬编码的密码、连接串凭据、API key
- rule_id: `hardcoded-secret`

### swallowed-error（error）
- 用 `let _ =` 静默丢弃 Result（无日志、无处理）
- rule_id: `swallowed-error`

### todo-marker（warning）
- 生产代码中遗留的 `todo!()` / `unimplemented!()`
- rule_id: `todo-marker`

每个 finding 附带 location（文件 + 行号）与证据（代码片段）。

</skill>

+//! Request handlers.
+
+use std::io::{Read, Write};
+use std::net::TcpStream;
+
+/// Read one HTTP request line from the stream.
+fn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<String> {
+    let mut buf = [0u8; 1024];
+    let n = stream.read(&mut buf)?;
+    Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]).to_string())
+}
+
+/// Handle a single client connection.
+pub fn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {
+    let request = read_request(&mut stream)?;
+    let mut parts = request.split_whitespace();
+    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or("GET");
+    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or("/");
+
+    match (method, path) {
+        ("GET", "/health") => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\nok")?;
+        }
+        ("GET", path) if path.starts_with("/users/") => {
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on a parse that can fail — panic on a
+            // malformed id path.
+            let id: u64 = path.trim_start_matches("/users/").parse().unwrap();
+            let _ = id;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        ("POST", "/orders") => {
+            let mut body = String::new();
+            stream.read_to_string(&mut body)?;
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on user-controlled JSON — panic on a
+            // malformed payload.
+            let payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&body).unwrap();
+            let _ = payload;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 201 Created\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        _ => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\nnot found")?;
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Request middleware (logging, auth header validation).
+
+/// Extract the bearer token from a request's header lines.
+pub fn bearer_token(request: &str) -> Option<String> {
+    for line in request.lines() {
+        if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("Authorization: Bearer ") {
+            if !rest.trim().is_empty() {
+                return Some(rest.trim().to_string());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    None
+}
+
+/// Validate that a token is non-empty and has the expected prefix.
+pub fn validate_token(token: &str) -> bool {
+    token.len() >= 16 && (token.starts_with("svc_") || token.starts_with("dev_"))
+}

+//! Domain types shared across the service.
+
+use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
+
+/// A user record as stored in the database.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct User {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub username: String,
+    pub email: String,
+    pub active: bool,
+}
+
+impl User {
+    /// A user is displayable when both fields are non-empty.
+    pub fn display_name(&self) -> String {
+        if self.username.is_empty() {
+            self.email.clone()
+        } else {
+            self.username.clone()
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// An order placed by a user.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct Order {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub user_id: u64,
+    pub items: Vec<OrderItem>,
+}
+
+/// A single line item on an order.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct OrderItem {
+    pub sku: String,
+    pub quantity: u32,
+}
+
+/// Validation result for an incoming order.
+pub fn validate_order(order: &Order) -> Result<(), String> {
+    if order.items.is_empty() {
+        return Err("order must contain at least one item".to_string());
+    }
+    for item in &order.items {
+        if item.quantity == 0 {
+            return Err(format!("item {} has zero quantity", item.sku));
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or("/");

+    match (method, path) {

+//! Request middleware (logging, auth header validation).
+
+/// Extract the bearer token from a request's header lines.
+pub fn bearer_token(request: &str) -> Option<String> {
+    for line in request.lines() {
+        if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("Authorization: Bearer ") {
+            if !rest.trim().is_empty() {
+                return Some(rest.trim().to_string());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    None
+}
+
+/// Validate that a token is non-empty and has the expected prefix.
+pub fn validate_token(token: &str) -> bool {
+    token.len() >= 16 && (token.starts_with("svc_") || token.starts_with("dev_"))
+}

+//! Request handlers.
+
+use std::io::{Read, Write};
+use std::net::TcpStream;
+
+/// Read one HTTP request line from the stream.
+fn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<String> {
+    let mut buf = [0u8; 1024];
+    let n = stream.read(&mut buf)?;
+    Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]).to_string())
+}
+
+/// Handle a single client connection.
+pub fn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {
+    let request = read_request(&mut stream)?;
+    let mut parts = request.split_whitespace();
+    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or("GET");
+    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or("/");
+
+    match (method, path) {
+        ("GET", "/health") => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\nok")?;
+        }
+        ("GET", path) if path.starts_with("/users/") => {
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on a parse that can fail — panic on a
+            // malformed id path.
+            let id: u64 = path.trim_start_matches("/users/").parse().unwrap();
+            let _ = id;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        ("POST", "/orders") => {
+            let mut body = String::new();
+            stream.read_to_string(&mut body)?;
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on user-controlled JSON — panic on a
+            // malformed payload.
+            let payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&body).unwrap();
+            let _ = payload;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 201 Created\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        _ => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\nnot found")?;
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Request handlers.
+
+use std::io::{Read, Write};
+use std::net::TcpStream;
+
+/// Read one HTTP request line from the stream.
+fn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<String> {
+    let mut buf = [0u8; 1024];
+    let n = stream.read(&mut buf)?;
+    Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]).to_string())
+}
+
+/// Handle a single client connection.
+pub fn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {
+    let request = read_request(&mut stream)?;
+    let mut parts = request.split_whitespace();
+    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or("GET");
+    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or("/");
+
+    match (method, path) {
+        ("GET", "/health") => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\nok")?;
+        }
+        ("GET", path) if path.starts_with("/users/") => {
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on a parse that can fail — panic on a
+            // malformed id path.
+            let id: u64 = path.trim_start_matches("/users/").parse().unwrap();
+            let _ = id;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        ("POST", "/orders") => {
+            let mut body = String::new();
+            stream.read_to_string(&mut body)?;
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on user-controlled JSON — panic on a
+            // malformed payload.
+            let payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&body).unwrap();
+            let _ = payload;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 201 Created\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        _ => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\nnot found")?;
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Request middleware (logging, auth header validation).
+
+/// Extract the bearer token from a request's header lines.
+pub fn bearer_token(request: &str) -> Option<String> {
+    for line in request.lines() {
+        if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("Authorization: Bearer ") {
+            if !rest.trim().is_empty() {
+                return Some(rest.trim().to_string());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    None
+}
+
+/// Validate that a token is non-empty and has the expected prefix.
+pub fn validate_token(token: &str) -> bool {
+    token.len() >= 16 && (token.starts_with("svc_") || token.starts_with("dev_"))
+}

+//! Domain types shared across the service.
+
+use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
+
+/// A user record as stored in the database.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct User {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub username: String,
+    pub email: String,
+    pub active: bool,
+}
+
+impl User {
+    /// A user is displayable when both fields are non-empty.
+    pub fn display_name(&self) -> String {
+        if self.username.is_empty() {
+            self.email.clone()
+        } else {
+            self.username.clone()
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// An order placed by a user.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct Order {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub user_id: u64,
+    pub items: Vec<OrderItem>,
+}
+
+/// A single line item on an order.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct OrderItem {
+    pub sku: String,
+    pub quantity: u32,
+}
+
+/// Validation result for an incoming order.
+pub fn validate_order(order: &Order) -> Result<(), String> {
+    if order.items.is_empty() {
+        return Err("order must contain at least one item".to_string());
+    }
+    for item in &order.items {
+        if item.quantity == 0 {
+            return Err(format!("item {} has zero quantity", item.sku));
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+/// Read one HTTP request line from the stream.

+    let n = stream.read(&mut buf)?;
+    Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]).to_string())
+}
+
+/// Handle a single client connection.

+    let request = read_request(&mut stream)?;
+    let mut parts = request.split_whitespace();
+    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or("GET");
+    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or("/");
+
+    match (method, path) {
+        ("GET", "/health") => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\nok")?;
+        }
+        ("GET", path) if path.starts_with("/users/") => {
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on a parse that can fail — panic on a

+            let id: u64 = path.trim_start_matches("/users/").parse().unwrap();
+            let _ = id;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        ("POST", "/orders") => {
+            let mut body = String::new();
+            stream.read_to_string(&mut body)?;
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on user-controlled JSON — panic on a

+        }

+//! Request middleware (logging, auth header validation).
+
+/// Extract the bearer token from a request's header lines.
+pub fn bearer_token(request: &str) -> Option<String> {
+    for line in request.lines() {
+        if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("Authorization: Bearer ") {
+            if !rest.trim().is_empty() {
+                return Some(rest.trim().to_string());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    None
+}
+
+/// Validate that a token is non-empty and has the expected prefix.
+pub fn validate_token(token: &str) -> bool {
+    token.len() >= 16 && (token.starts_with("svc_") || token.starts_with("dev_"))
+}

+//! Domain types shared across the service.
+
+use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
+
+/// A user record as stored in the database.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct User {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub username: String,
+    pub email: String,
+    pub active: bool,
+}
+
+impl User {
+    /// A user is displayable when both fields are non-empty.
+    pub fn display_name(&self) -> String {
+        if self.username.is_empty() {
+            self.email.clone()
+        } else {
+            self.username.clone()
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// An order placed by a user.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct Order {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub user_id: u64,
+    pub items: Vec<OrderItem>,
+}
+
+/// A single line item on an order.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct OrderItem {
+    pub sku: String,
+    pub quantity: u32,
+}
+
+/// Validation result for an incoming order.
+pub fn validate_order(order: &Order) -> Result<(), String> {
+    if order.items.is_empty() {
+        return Err("order must contain at least one item".to_string());
+    }
+    for item in &order.items {
+        if item.quantity == 0 {
+            return Err(format!("item {} has zero quantity", item.sku));
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Request handlers.
+
+use std::io::{Read, Write};
+use std::net::TcpStream;
+
+/// Read one HTTP request line from the stream.
+fn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<String> {
+    let mut buf = [0u8; 1024];
+    let n = stream.read(&mut buf)?;
+    Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]).to_string())
+}
+
+/// Handle a single client connection.
+pub fn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {
+    let request = read_request(&mut stream)?;
+    let mut parts = request.split_whitespace();
+    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or("GET");
+    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or("/");
+
+    match (method, path) {
+        ("GET", "/health") => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\nok")?;
+        }
+        ("GET", path) if path.starts_with("/users/") => {
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on a parse that can fail — panic on a
+            // malformed id path.
+            let id: u64 = path.trim_start_matches("/users/").parse().unwrap();
+            let _ = id;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        ("POST", "/orders") => {
+            let mut body = String::new();
+            stream.read_to_string(&mut body)?;
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on user-controlled JSON — panic on a
+            // malformed payload.
+            let payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&body).unwrap();
+            let _ = payload;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 201 Created\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        _ => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\nnot found")?;
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Request handlers.
+
+use std::io::{Read, Write};
+use std::net::TcpStream;
+
+/// Read one HTTP request line from the stream.
+fn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<String> {
+    let mut buf = [0u8; 1024];
+    let n = stream.read(&mut buf)?;
+    Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]).to_string())
+}
+
+/// Handle a single client connection.
+pub fn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {
+    let request = read_request(&mut stream)?;
+    let mut parts = request.split_whitespace();
+    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or("GET");
+    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or("/");
+
+    match (method, path) {
+        ("GET", "/health") => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\nok")?;
+        }
+        ("GET", path) if path.starts_with("/users/") => {
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on a parse that can fail — panic on a
+            // malformed id path.
+            let id: u64 = path.trim_start_matches("/users/").parse().unwrap();
+            let _ = id;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        ("POST", "/orders") => {
+            let mut body = String::new();
+            stream.read_to_string(&mut body)?;
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on user-controlled JSON — panic on a
+            // malformed payload.
+            let payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&body).unwrap();
+            let _ = payload;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 201 Created\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        _ => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\nnot found")?;
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Request middleware (logging, auth header validation).
+
+/// Extract the bearer token from a request's header lines.
+pub fn bearer_token(request: &str) -> Option<String> {
+    for line in request.lines() {
+        if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("Authorization: Bearer ") {
+            if !rest.trim().is_empty() {
+                return Some(rest.trim().to_string());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    None
+}

+    token.len() >= 16 && (token.starts_with("svc_") || token.starts_with("dev_"))
+}

+//! Request handlers.
+
+use std::io::{Read, Write};
+use std::net::TcpStream;
+
+/// Read one HTTP request line from the stream.
+fn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<String> {
+    let mut buf = [0u8; 1024];
+    let n = stream.read(&mut buf)?;
+    Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]).to_string())
+}
+
+/// Handle a single client connection.
+pub fn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {
+    let request = read_request(&mut stream)?;
+    let mut parts = request.split_whitespace();
+    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or("GET");
+    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or("/");
+
+    match (method, path) {
+        ("GET", "/health") => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\nok")?;
+        }
+        ("GET", path) if path.starts_with("/users/") => {
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on a parse that can fail — panic on a
+            // malformed id path.
+            let id: u64 = path.trim_start_matches("/users/").parse().unwrap();
+            let _ = id;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        ("POST", "/orders") => {
+            let mut body = String::new();
+            stream.read_to_string(&mut body)?;
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on user-controlled JSON — panic on a
+            // malformed payload.
+            let payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&body).unwrap();
+            let _ = payload;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 201 Created\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        _ => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\nnot found")?;
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Request middleware (logging, auth header validation).
+
+/// Extract the bearer token from a request's header lines.
+pub fn bearer_token(request: &str) -> Option<String> {
+    for line in request.lines() {
+        if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("Authorization: Bearer ") {
+            if !rest.trim().is_empty() {
+                return Some(rest.trim().to_string());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    None
+}
+
+/// Validate that a token is non-empty and has the expected prefix.
+pub fn validate_token(token: &str) -> bool {
+    token.len() >= 16 && (token.starts_with("svc_") || token.starts_with("dev_"))
+}

+//! Domain types shared across the service.
+
+use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
+
+/// A user record as stored in the database.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct User {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub username: String,
+    pub email: String,
+    pub active: bool,
+}
+
+impl User {
+    /// A user is displayable when both fields are non-empty.
+    pub fn display_name(&self) -> String {
+        if self.username.is_empty() {
+            self.email.clone()
+        } else {
+            self.username.clone()
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// An order placed by a user.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct Order {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub user_id: u64,
+    pub items: Vec<OrderItem>,
+}
+
+/// A single line item on an order.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct OrderItem {
+    pub sku: String,
+    pub quantity: u32,
+}
+
+/// Validation result for an incoming order.
+pub fn validate_order(order: &Order) -> Result<(), String> {
+    if order.items.is_empty() {
+        return Err("order must contain at least one item".to_string());
+    }
+    for item in &order.items {
+        if item.quantity == 0 {
+            return Err(format!("item {} has zero quantity", item.sku));
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Domain types shared across the service.
+
+use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
+
+/// A user record as stored in the database.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct User {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub username: String,
+    pub email: String,
+    pub active: bool,
+}
+
+impl User {
+    /// A user is displayable when both fields are non-empty.
+    pub fn display_name(&self) -> String {
+        if self.username.is_empty() {
+            self.email.clone()
+        } else {
+            self.username.clone()
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// An order placed by a user.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct Order {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub user_id: u64,
+    pub items: Vec<OrderItem>,
+}
+
+/// A single line item on an order.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct OrderItem {
+    pub sku: String,
+    pub quantity: u32,
+}
+
+/// Validation result for an incoming order.
+pub fn validate_order(order: &Order) -> Result<(), String> {
+    if order.items.is_empty() {
+        return Err("order must contain at least one item".to_string());
+    }
+    for item in &order.items {
+        if item.quantity == 0 {
+            return Err(format!("item {} has zero quantity", item.sku));
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Request handlers.
+
+use std::io::{Read, Write};
+use std::net::TcpStream;
+
+/// Read one HTTP request line from the stream.
+fn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<String> {
+    let mut buf = [0u8; 1024];
+    let n = stream.read(&mut buf)?;
+    Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]).to_string())
+}
+
+/// Handle a single client connection.
+pub fn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {
+    let request = read_request(&mut stream)?;
+    let mut parts = request.split_whitespace();
+    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or("GET");
+    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or("/");
+
+    match (method, path) {
+        ("GET", "/health") => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\nok")?;
+        }
+        ("GET", path) if path.starts_with("/users/") => {
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on a parse that can fail — panic on a
+            // malformed id path.
+            let id: u64 = path.trim_start_matches("/users/").parse().unwrap();
+            let _ = id;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        ("POST", "/orders") => {
+            let mut body = String::new();
+            stream.read_to_string(&mut body)?;
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on user-controlled JSON — panic on a
+            // malformed payload.
+            let payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&body).unwrap();
+            let _ = payload;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 201 Created\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        _ => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\nnot found")?;
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Request middleware (logging, auth header validation).
+
+/// Extract the bearer token from a request's header lines.
+pub fn bearer_token(request: &str) -> Option<String> {
+    for line in request.lines() {
+        if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("Authorization: Bearer ") {
+            if !rest.trim().is_empty() {
+                return Some(rest.trim().to_string());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    None
+}
+
+/// Validate that a token is non-empty and has the expected prefix.
+pub fn validate_token(token: &str) -> bool {
+    token.len() >= 16 && (token.starts_with("svc_") || token.starts_with("dev_"))
+}

+//! Request handlers.
+
+use std::io::{Read, Write};
+use std::net::TcpStream;
+
+/// Read one HTTP request line from the stream.
+fn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<String> {
+    let mut buf = [0u8; 1024];
+    let n = stream.read(&mut buf)?;
+    Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]).to_string())
+}
+
+/// Handle a single client connection.
+pub fn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {
+    let request = read_request(&mut stream)?;
+    let mut parts = request.split_whitespace();
+    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or("GET");
+    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or("/");
+
+    match (method, path) {
+        ("GET", "/health") => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\nok")?;
+        }
+        ("GET", path) if path.starts_with("/users/") => {
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on a parse that can fail — panic on a
+            // malformed id path.
+            let id: u64 = path.trim_start_matches("/users/").parse().unwrap();
+            let _ = id;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        ("POST", "/orders") => {
+            let mut body = String::new();
+            stream.read_to_string(&mut body)?;
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on user-controlled JSON — panic on a
+            // malformed payload.
+            let payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&body).unwrap();
+            let _ = payload;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 201 Created\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        _ => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\nnot found")?;
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Request middleware (logging, auth header validation).

+/// Extract the bearer token from a request's header lines.

+    for line in request.lines() {

+            }

+//! Domain types shared across the service.
+
+use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};

+/// A user record as stored in the database.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]

+    pub active: bool,

+impl User {
+    /// A user is displayable when both fields are non-empty.
+    pub fn display_name(&self) -> String {
+        if self.username.is_empty() {
+            self.email.clone()
+        } else {
+            self.username.clone()
+        }
+    }

+//! Request handlers.
+
+use std::io::{Read, Write};
+use std::net::TcpStream;
+
+/// Read one HTTP request line from the stream.
+fn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<String> {
+    let mut buf = [0u8; 1024];
+    let n = stream.read(&mut buf)?;
+    Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]).to_string())
+}
+
+/// Handle a single client connection.
+pub fn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {
+    let request = read_request(&mut stream)?;
+    let mut parts = request.split_whitespace();
+    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or("GET");
+    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or("/");
+
+    match (method, path) {
+        ("GET", "/health") => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\nok")?;
+        }
+        ("GET", path) if path.starts_with("/users/") => {
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on a parse that can fail — panic on a
+            // malformed id path.
+            let id: u64 = path.trim_start_matches("/users/").parse().unwrap();
+            let _ = id;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        ("POST", "/orders") => {
+            let mut body = String::new();
+            stream.read_to_string(&mut body)?;
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on user-controlled JSON — panic on a
+            // malformed payload.
+            let payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&body).unwrap();
+            let _ = payload;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 201 Created\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        _ => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\nnot found")?;
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Request middleware (logging, auth header validation).
+
+/// Extract the bearer token from a request's header lines.
+pub fn bearer_token(request: &str) -> Option<String> {
+    for line in request.lines() {
+        if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("Authorization: Bearer ") {
+            if !rest.trim().is_empty() {
+                return Some(rest.trim().to_string());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    None
+}
+
+/// Validate that a token is non-empty and has the expected prefix.
+pub fn validate_token(token: &str) -> bool {
+    token.len() >= 16 && (token.starts_with("svc_") || token.starts_with("dev_"))
+}

+//! Domain types shared across the service.
+
+use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
+
+/// A user record as stored in the database.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct User {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub username: String,
+    pub email: String,
+    pub active: bool,
+}
+
+impl User {
+    /// A user is displayable when both fields are non-empty.
+    pub fn display_name(&self) -> String {
+        if self.username.is_empty() {
+            self.email.clone()
+        } else {
+            self.username.clone()
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// An order placed by a user.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct Order {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub user_id: u64,
+    pub items: Vec<OrderItem>,
+}
+
+/// A single line item on an order.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct OrderItem {
+    pub sku: String,
+    pub quantity: u32,
+}
+
+/// Validation result for an incoming order.
+pub fn validate_order(order: &Order) -> Result<(), String> {
+    if order.items.is_empty() {
+        return Err("order must contain at least one item".to_string());
+    }
+    for item in &order.items {
+        if item.quantity == 0 {
+            return Err(format!("item {} has zero quantity", item.sku));
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Request handlers.
+
+use std::io::{Read, Write};
+use std::net::TcpStream;
+
+/// Read one HTTP request line from the stream.
+fn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<String> {
+    let mut buf = [0u8; 1024];
+    let n = stream.read(&mut buf)?;
+    Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]).to_string())
+}
+
+/// Handle a single client connection.
+pub fn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {
+    let request = read_request(&mut stream)?;
+    let mut parts = request.split_whitespace();
+    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or("GET");
+    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or("/");
+
+    match (method, path) {
+        ("GET", "/health") => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\nok")?;
+        }
+        ("GET", path) if path.starts_with("/users/") => {
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on a parse that can fail — panic on a
+            // malformed id path.
+            let id: u64 = path.trim_start_matches("/users/").parse().unwrap();
+            let _ = id;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        ("POST", "/orders") => {
+            let mut body = String::new();
+            stream.read_to_string(&mut body)?;
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on user-controlled JSON — panic on a
+            // malformed payload.
+            let payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&body).unwrap();
+            let _ = payload;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 201 Created\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        _ => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\nnot found")?;
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Request middleware (logging, auth header validation).
+
+/// Extract the bearer token from a request's header lines.
+pub fn bearer_token(request: &str) -> Option<String> {
+    for line in request.lines() {
+        if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("Authorization: Bearer ") {
+            if !rest.trim().is_empty() {
+                return Some(rest.trim().to_string());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    None
+}
+
+/// Validate that a token is non-empty and has the expected prefix.
+pub fn validate_token(token: &str) -> bool {
+    token.len() >= 16 && (token.starts_with("svc_") || token.starts_with("dev_"))
+}

+//! Domain types shared across the service.
+
+use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
+
+/// A user record as stored in the database.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct User {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub username: String,
+    pub email: String,
+    pub active: bool,
+}
+
+impl User {
+    /// A user is displayable when both fields are non-empty.
+    pub fn display_name(&self) -> String {
+        if self.username.is_empty() {
+            self.email.clone()
+        } else {
+            self.username.clone()
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// An order placed by a user.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct Order {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub user_id: u64,
+    pub items: Vec<OrderItem>,
+}
+
+/// A single line item on an order.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct OrderItem {
+    pub sku: String,
+    pub quantity: u32,
+}
+
+/// Validation result for an incoming order.
+pub fn validate_order(order: &Order) -> Result<(), String> {
+    if order.items.is_empty() {
+        return Err("order must contain at least one item".to_string());
+    }
+    for item in &order.items {
+        if item.quantity == 0 {
+            return Err(format!("item {} has zero quantity", item.sku));
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Request handlers.
+
+use std::io::{Read, Write};
+use std::net::TcpStream;
+
+/// Read one HTTP request line from the stream.
+fn read_request(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<String> {
+    let mut buf = [0u8; 1024];
+    let n = stream.read(&mut buf)?;
+    Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..n]).to_string())
+}
+
+/// Handle a single client connection.
+pub fn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {
+    let request = read_request(&mut stream)?;
+    let mut parts = request.split_whitespace();
+    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or("GET");
+    let path = parts.next().unwrap_or("/");
+
+    match (method, path) {
+        ("GET", "/health") => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\nok")?;
+        }
+        ("GET", path) if path.starts_with("/users/") => {
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on a parse that can fail — panic on a
+            // malformed id path.
+            let id: u64 = path.trim_start_matches("/users/").parse().unwrap();
+            let _ = id;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        ("POST", "/orders") => {
+            let mut body = String::new();
+            stream.read_to_string(&mut body)?;
+            // Seeded defect: unwrap on user-controlled JSON — panic on a
+            // malformed payload.
+            let payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&body).unwrap();
+            let _ = payload;
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 201 Created\r\n\r\n{}")?;
+        }
+        _ => {
+            stream.write_all(b"HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\nnot found")?;
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}

+//! Request middleware (logging, auth header validation).
+
+/// Extract the bearer token from a request's header lines.
+pub fn bearer_token(request: &str) -> Option<String> {
+    for line in request.lines() {
+        if let Some(rest) = line.strip_prefix("Authorization: Bearer ") {
+            if !rest.trim().is_empty() {
+                return Some(rest.trim().to_string());
+            }
+        }
+    }
+    None
+}
+
+/// Validate that a token is non-empty and has the expected prefix.
+pub fn validate_token(token: &str) -> bool {
+    token.len() >= 16 && (token.starts_with("svc_") || token.starts_with("dev_"))
+}

+//! Domain types shared across the service.
+
+use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
+
+/// A user record as stored in the database.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct User {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub username: String,
+    pub email: String,
+    pub active: bool,
+}
+
+impl User {
+    /// A user is displayable when both fields are non-empty.
+    pub fn display_name(&self) -> String {
+        if self.username.is_empty() {
+            self.email.clone()
+        } else {
+            self.username.clone()
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+/// An order placed by a user.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct Order {
+    pub id: u64,
+    pub user_id: u64,
+    pub items: Vec<OrderItem>,
+}
+
+/// A single line item on an order.
+#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
+pub struct OrderItem {
+    pub sku: String,
+    pub quantity: u32,
+}
+
+/// Validation result for an incoming order.
+pub fn validate_order(order: &Order) -> Result<(), String> {
+    if order.items.is_empty() {
+        return Err("order must contain at least one item".to_string());
+    }
+    for item in &order.items {
+        if item.quantity == 0 {
+            return Err(format!("item {} has zero quantity", item.sku));
+        }
+    }
+    Ok(())
+}
